notes.title: PIGFACE is available now in Early Access!
notes.notes: [p]Yo! It's release day today![/p][p]After a short delay and lots of polishing, I'm super stoked to be releasing [b][i]PIGFACE[/i][/b] into Early Access. It's been a long road to get to this point, but it's been immensely gratifying every step of the way. [/p][p]It's kind of weird seeing [b][i]PIGFACE[/i][/b] evolving from a prototype into a game, I still remember the feeling I got the first time I was able to load into a level from the apartment -- it started to make the game feel like it was part of a world. Now, there are a few more levels, with plenty to come, and that feeling of persistence has kept growing. [/p][p]My hope is that by the time 1.0 rolls around, [b][i]PIGFACE[/i][/b] will feel like a part of something a lot bigger than itself. That was one of the main goals I had, internally, for this project. A goal that went beyond just gameplay and aesthetic. I feel like, for me, games are really magical when they can sell you the idea that there's something beyond the billboarded background trees and closed-off doorways at the map's boundaries. I tried to put some of that magic in [b][i]PIGFACE[/i][/b], just a bit.[/p][p]Anyways, I hope you guys enjoy the launch! I'm already hard at work for the first content update that'll keep pushing the game and its story forward. I can't wait to hear all the feedback and see all the videos people make about the game. Get in there and get the job done >:) [/p][p]- tito[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="IIEopOEacDg;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]p.s. as always, thank you for your bug reports and feedback. This ongoing process wouldn't be possible without your help and support! if you come across any issues, [url="https://discord.gg/PX25QrbGrw"]come tell us in the bug reporting channel on our discord server[/url] or in the steam discussion forums so we can help you out![/p]

notes.title: PIGFACE Early Access Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes: [p]hello![/p][p]at long last, early access is just around the corner! it’s been a lot of work but i think you guys are really gonna like it. [/p][p]also, i just gotta say, having so many conversations at PAX where people showed their love for the game and their love of games gave me the fuel i needed to finish up the content for this EA release. [/p][p]i can’t express enough how much it means to me that people are eager and willing to chat with devs and share their thoughts and life experiences, it’s amazing. [/p][p]i hope that once this is out you guys will enjoy it a lot and share your experiences so that i can apply that feedback and make the game better and more polished as time goes on. at the end of the day, i’m making a game for you guys. [/p][p]see you in a week![/p][p][/p][p]-tito[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="2Ttv1yOlWzs;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: PIGFACE - EARLY ACCESS AUGUST 2025
notes.notes:
[h3][b]EARLY ACCESS AUGUST 2025[/b][/h3][p]
[/p][p]What a two-for-one special, eh? A really cool demo, quickly followed up by a PC Gaming Show Early Access reveal trailer … [/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="MkmsDd-IiUg;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
[/p][p]I’m [i]still [/i]picking up the bits of my pants that were blown off.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Anyways, as I’m sure you’re aware, PIGFACE is slated for an August EA release, so if you liked the demo you’re probably pretty damn happy. By the time that month rolls around, these forum posts are going to start discussing content updates to the game. [/p][p]
[/p][p]What I’m really looking forward to with EA are the reactions to the new levels — as much as the demo was dark and dismal, I want a handful of PIGFACE’s locations to be explored during the day. In the first content update you’ll get to see a daytime level that I think you’re all [i]really [/i]going to like. It’s one of my personal favourites and actually one of the first level ideas I even had for this project waaaaay back in 2022.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Along with the content updates, the levels are also going to get bigger and more interesting as you expand your loadout and find more masks that alter the way you approach the game. Basically it’s just gonna be even [i]more [/i]exciting stuff.[/p][p]
[/p][p]I hope you guys liked the demo, and I hope you’re excited to see what I’ve got planned for the content updates during Early Access. This game is gonna be really fuckin’ fun, man.[/p][p]
[/p][p]~ Tito[/p]

notes.title: PIGFACE Demo Release
notes.notes:
[p]Finally, after a whole heap of work, the [b]PIGFACE[/b] demo is ready! Are you excited? I sure am…
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610995/5ae5eeca4dade42ef5a35ab6412784f4f229134c.gif"][/img][/p][p]I’ve tried to polish the hell out of this thing, but honestly I just can’t wait to see clips of people finding all sorts of weird bugs and messing around with the goofy ragdolls. It’ll be for my enjoyment, but it’ll also show me the busted stuff that needs fixing and the cool shit that needs spit-shining.[/p][p][/p][p]Most importantly though, I just can’t want to see everyone having fun. [/p][p][/p][p]I’m pretty confident that this demo will give you guys a very good idea of what my vision is for the full thing. The fact that the gameplay loop is basically finalized means that this demo will give you a good idea of how it will [i]actually feel [/i]to play the full game. 
[/p][p]It’s not just a combat showcase anymore, it’s the [b][i][u]real[/u][/i][/b][i] [/i]thing this time.  [/p][p][/p][p]Anyways what are you doing reading this? [b]Install the damn thing and play it[/b]. Or if you’ve already done that, play it again. And then [u]tell all your friends[/u], I’m sure they are absolutely dying to [b]wishlist this game[/b]...[/p][p]~ Tito

notes.title: PIGFACE
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello![/h1]

Right out of the gate I want to let you guys know that [b][i]PIGFACE[/i] has been fully funded and will be published by DreadXP! It’s fuckin’ great![/b]

Aside from being paid, the best part about this is that [i]PIGFACE[/i] now has a definite direction — it doesn’t just reside in my head anymore. I even [b]wrote a whole design document and have an internal schedule with deadlines and stuff[/b], it’s cool as hell. 

[previewyoutube=d5yXOY-kgdE;full][/previewyoutube]

The little demo I made a year ago was one thing, but an entire game is something else, and I’m happy to say that my life has been made much easier by having a team of people to turn to for help.

What this all means is that [i]PIGFACE[/i] will be completed, no matter what. I now have the finances, support, and time to focus on turning this grungy procrastination project into a fully realized game. 

Anyways, I won’t write too much, I’ll start rambling if I go on. But to reiterate: [i]PIGFACE[/i] is fully funded and I cannot wait for the future of the game.[u] It’s gonna be so sick.[/u]

~ Tito
